scenario: Volleyball player wants a high-carb meal plan for the day before a game
goal: Gain energy for a high-intensity volleyball game
solutionCriteria:
- 2500-2800 kcal total energy
- At least 4 servings of complex carbohydrates
- Include lean protein sources (chicken, fish, beans)
- Less than 50g of fat
- Drink at least 2 liters of water

scenario: Endurance runner needs a low-calorie meal plan to help manage weight
goal: Maintain weight for optimal running performance
solutionCriteria:
- 1800-2000 kcal total energy
- At least 3 servings of whole grains
- Include plant-based protein sources (lentils, tofu, tempeh)
- Less than 30g of fat per meal
- Incorporate hydrating foods (cucumbers, celery)

scenario: Powerlifter requires a high-protein meal plan to aid muscle recovery
goal: Optimize muscle recovery after a powerlifting competition
solutionCriteria:
- 3500-4000 kcal total energy
- At least 5 servings of lean protein sources (chicken, fish, beef)
- Include complex carbohydrates (brown rice, whole wheat)
- Less than 40g of fat per meal
- Hydrate with a post-workout supplement

scenario: Cyclist needs a balanced meal plan to improve overall health
goal: Promote overall health and well-being through nutrition
solutionCriteria:
- 2500-2800 kcal total energy
- At least 3 servings of whole grains (gluten-free options)
- Include a variety of fruits and vegetables
- Moderate consumption of lean protein and healthy fats
- Drink at least 1 liter of water per hour of cycling

scenario: Triathlete requires a specialized meal plan to accommodate a food intolerance
solutionCriteria:
- 2000-2200 kcal total energy
- At least 3 servings of complex carbohydrates
- Include lactose-free protein sources (rice protein, eggs)
- Moderate consumption of healthy fats
- Stay hydrated with electrolyte-rich beverages

scenario: Swimmer aims to maintain muscle mass while in a calorie deficit
goal: Support muscle maintenance during a calorie deficit
solutionCriteria:
- 2000-2200 kcal total energy
- At least 4 servings of lean protein sources
- Include complex carbohydrates to support muscle function
- Less than 30g of fat per meal
- Incorporate strength training exercises

scenario: Dancer needs a high-fiber meal plan to manage energy levels
goal: Maintain energy levels throughout a long rehearsal day
solutionCriteria:
- 2200-2500 kcal total energy
- At least 5 servings of whole grains
- Include plant-based sources of omega-3 fatty acids (flaxseeds, walnuts)
- Moderate consumption of healthy fats
- Incorporate probiotic-rich foods (yogurt alternatives)

scenario: Gymnast requires a meal plan to support bone health during intense training
solutionCriteria:
- 2500-2800 kcal total energy
- At least 3 servings of calcium-rich foods (dairy, fortified plant-based milk)
- Include vitamin D-fortified foods (fortified orange juice, mushrooms)
- Moderate consumption of healthy fats
- Engage in weight-bearing exercises 2-3 times a week
